name: pm-rl
description: Reinforcement-learning programme management on the pm SDK. Environments and reward specifications version rather than mutate, so a result stays attributable; a run's metric series is appended to pm's history stream, which unions losslessly under concurrent writers on separate branches; benchmarks, eval results and sim-to-real transfer gaps carry full provenance through the pm dependency graph. Commands: `pm rl env register/list/show`, `pm rl run start/log/finish/verify`, `pm rl sweep plan/status`, `pm rl bench run/report`, `pm rl transfer measure/gap`, `pm rl compare`, `pm rl leaderboard`, `pm rl invalidate`.
author: @unbraind
